name: Dreamscape Highschool!
source:
Dreamscape Highschool is a Comedy Romance genre where Fuyuki Setsuna, the main protagonist, wanders into a dream one night without knowing how. He then meets someone within that dream. Will this all be explained as to how this is happening? Will Fuyuki finally meet the girl of his dreams? The best way to find out is by playing Dreamscape Highschool.  I hope you all enjoy this story!

[From [url=https://nadare-aikami.itch.io/dreamscape-highschool]Itch.io[/url]]
